title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Socioeconomic
description: Employment, partnership, mobile phone use, and social group/activity participation, reported at the 3-year resurvey.

F1WRK.title: Currently in paid work
F1WRK.$comment: Available on every questionnaire version. Independent of the other fields in this category.

F1PART.title: Currently married or living with husband/partner
F1PART.$comment: Steward confirmed this gates F1PARTSM -- only a participant with a partner (F1PART=1) can answer whether that partner smokes.

F1PARTSM.title: Husband/partner smokes
F1PARTSM.x-universe: Participants who currently have a husband/partner (F1PART=1).
F1PARTSM.$comment: not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F1PART -- D073, steward-confirmed.

F1MOBFRQ.title: Mobile phone: current usage
F1MOBFRQ.$comment: Not available on the 9903/9907 versions (mobile phones were newer technology at the earliest fielding dates) -- no source-documented -1 code for this field, though, so no such sentinel is added; transcribed as given, not invented.

F1MOBYRS.title: Mobile phone: duration of use
F1MOBYRS.$comment: Steward confirmed no skip pair is needed against F1MOBFRQ -- a participant who has never used a mobile phone answers 0 directly, a real value, same reasoning as the alcohol trio (D058). Source states no valid range; 0-20 years is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling, given mobile phones were still a relatively new technology at this wave's fielding dates. Not available on the 9903/9907 versions, same as F1MOBFRQ.

F1ACTREL.title: Social groups/activities: religious group
F1ACTREL.$comment: Checkbox-style 'tick all that apply' list: the source documents only '1=Yes' for this field, no '2=No', and there is no gating field over the 9 activity checkboxes (unlike parental_mortality's cause-of-death block, which is gated by F1MALIVE) -- any non-1 value is generic missing_numeric.

F1ACTBIN.title: Social groups/activities: bingo
F1ACTBIN.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1ACTREL, but this field additionally documents its own -1='Not on questionnaire' code, lining up cleanly with its version-availability (No on 9903/9907, Yes on 9909/0012).
